changes.before: Ranni openly admits stealing Death and making the knives. Her plan requires another demigod to die simultaneously so that the Cursemark will split and she can lose only flesh. changes.after: Ranni openly admits stealing Death and making the knives. The item account confirms that she and Godwyn died simultaneously, splitting the Cursemark: she lost her flesh, while he lost his soul. The game does not state clearly how far this result was calculated in advance, or whether Ranni personally chose Godwyn and why.

changes.before: 她没有承诺温暖。她说的是寒冷、黑暗、恐惧与疑惑。没有地上的金光以后，人更可能迷路，也更难把自己的方向伪装成天意。
changes.after: 她没有承诺温暖。寒冷、黑暗、恐惧与疑惑，是她用来描述那趟远行的话，不等于替留下来的人预告共同的命运。沿着本文的读法，没有地上的金光以后，人更可能迷路，也更难把自己的方向伪装成天意。
